From an invertible positive time symbol D_t and symmetric normal flux D_n, it derives the spectral incoming projector Pi_in=(I-D_t^-1 D_n)/2 and proves rank-half, idempotence, negative/nonpositive flux, maximal nonpositive dimension, oriented-normal complementarity and covariant transport. claim_ceiling: Exact rational action-flux spectral-projector theorem for one conditional rank-four proxy. The invertible positive time symbol and symmetric normal flux give an involutive reduced symbol, so Pi_in=(I-D_t^-1 D_n)/2 is an idempotent rank-two projector. Its flux is negative on nonzero incoming vectors, its range is maximal nonpositive of dimension two, orientation reversal exchanges the spectral halves, and simultaneous orthogonal transport conjugates the family.
